title: Power Capital: Credentials
description: John Roberts' credentials: 16 years as a finance professional including 15 years at AWS and Amazon, University of Washington and Appalachian State education, and Corporate Finance Institute certifications in Construction Finance and Real Estate Appraisal.
ogDescription: Certifications, education, and recommendations behind Power Capital's data-center and infrastructure finance expertise.

blocks.heading: Credentials & experience
blocks.body: Sixteen years as a finance professional — including fifteen at AWS and Amazon — with a foundation in accounting and international business, and specialized certifications in construction and real estate finance.

cards.title: Construction Finance
cards.subtitle: Corporate Finance Institute (CFI)
cards.body: Specialized training in construction accounting, project-cost management, draw schedules, and the financial controls that keep development projects on budget and audit-ready.

cards.title: Real Estate Appraisal
cards.subtitle: Corporate Finance Institute (CFI)
cards.body: Formal grounding in real-estate valuation methods — income, cost, and sales-comparison approaches — to support underwriting, capital planning, and investment decisions.

blocks.heading: A foundation in accounting and international business.

cards.title: University of Washington
cards.subtitle: Michael G. Foster School of Business
cards.body: Graduate Certificate in Accounting — advanced study in financial and managerial accounting.

cards.title: Appalachian State University
cards.subtitle: Walker College of Business
cards.body: B.S. in International Business with a minor in German — graduated **Magna Cum Laude**.

blocks.heading: Recommendations
blocks.lead: What colleagues and leaders are saying about us.

quotes.quote: John played a key role as the Subject Matter Expert on complex, business-impacting automation across AWS Infrastructure Finance, Accounting, and Business. He is a key contributor in reducing risk to unblock innovations, with excellent communication and leadership skills — he works effortlessly to make Finance more efficient and effective through automation.
quotes.name: Malliet Nyambane
quotes.role: Sr. Business Analyst, Amazon Web Services (AWS)

quotes.quote: It was an honor working alongside John for 2 years at AWS supporting server infrastructure procurement and financial forecasting. He excels at creating and maintaining complex financial models so business partners and finance leaders could understand problems they otherwise wouldn't discover. John is willing to speak up for what is better for the team.
quotes.name: Derek Lau

quotes.quote: I had the pleasure to work with John on various large-scale fixed-asset automation programs solving some of the most challenging customer needs in AWS infrastructure. His organized and structured approach brought the program back on track and earned our customers' trust. He is an extremely collaborative, hard-working self-starter with a very tactful approach to solving complex problems.
quotes.name: Sy C.

quotes.quote: I had the pleasure working with John since 2019 as part of the Global Data Center Infrastructure Finance team. John was a force of nature in driving high standards in Infra, cutting waste and improving processes — all while navigating COVID-19, lockdowns, high inflation, and the fallout from the invasion of Ukraine. I especially enjoyed his passion to raise the bar and share knowledge across our finance community.
quotes.name: Marcin Peciak
quotes.role: FCMA, CGMA — Finance Manager @ Google Data Center Build Finance

quotes.quote: John works with passion and perseverance on every goal he takes. He is a true Amazonian, exemplifying the Leadership Principles of Ownership, Customer Obsession, Insist on the Highest Standards, and Bias for Action.
quotes.name: Fred Pergola
quotes.role: AdTech — Product Leader for Display Ads at Amazon

quotes.quote: While studying with John at Appalachian State, he showed superior effort and reliability on group projects, and was very helpful tutoring in Economics, Finance, and German. John is reliable, very outgoing, works very well with people, and is an outstanding person who strives to put his full attention and effort into succeeding no matter how hard the task.
quotes.name: Kevin Glasgow
